Aston Martin confirms Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll for 2027, leaving only four F1 seats open for next season.Haas is expected to keep Ollie Bearman and consider Rafael Camara, the current Formula 2 championship leader. [4]

As the current championship leader with an 81-point advantage over teammate George Russell, Antonelli's ability to recover from the midfield will be a critical test of his resilience. [1]

Ferrari junior and FIA Formula 2 Championship leader Rafael Camara is favourite to get the nod, having had competition from McLaren reserve driver Leo Fornaroli and Haas reserves Jack Doohan and Ryo Hirakawa. [5]

Ferrari had hoped the new ­regulations this season would ­present a chance to once more compete for the title but while they are second in the constructors’ championship they are 160 points off the leaders, Mercedes. [7]
